summary.text: Joel Kitchens is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 1, where he took office on January 5, 2015, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election against Democrat Renee Paplham.
His professional background is in founding and owning a veterinary business.

paragraphs.text: Joel Kitchens founded and owned an animal veterinary business before serving in the legislature.
He has served in the Assembly since January 2015.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Agriculture, Education, Environment, Health and Tourism committees and chaired the Education Committee, a role he also held in 2023-2024.
